_help: Master index for the Ministry Outreach cards on news.html and the newsletter on testimonies.html. Each entry points to a folder under assets/images/ministry-outreach/{folder}/ that contains an images.json manifest. Add new events by (1) creating a new folder, (2) dropping photos/videos + an images.json manifest inside it, and (3) appending a new entry to the 'events' list below. Keep 'events' ordered most-recent-first. The 'body_extended' field supports longer narrative text shown on the newsletter page (optional — 'body' is used alone if body_extended is empty).

events.title: One Heart MVMT — Community Cookout
events.body: Joined Sam Petrov and One Heart MVMT at Wiggums Hollow Park for a Community Cookout — free food, prizes, and a bouncy castle for the kids. Sam preached, made an altar call, and people came forward for prayer and healing. Seed the Word was there with Bibles for every hand that reached out.

events.title: LGBTQ+ Community Outreach with For Zion Ministries
events.body: Out with Keegan and For Zion in Lake Stevens. We sat with the LGBTQ+ community, asked questions, listened, prayed when it was wanted.

events.title: Slavic Christian Awakening Evangelism
events.body: Partnered with Slavic Christian Awakening Church for a day of open-air evangelism in the heart of Bellevue Square Park. Conversations, prayer, and pocket Bibles shared with passersby.

events.title: Fishers of Men — UW Seattle
events.body: A day on the UW campus with the Fishers of Men team — student conversations, pocket Gideon NTs handed out, and prayers over the next generation walking those halls.
